Brain-CT-Seg: AI for Brain Tumor Segmentation & Risk Volumetry

Overcoming Machine, Deep Learning, and Clinical Radiologist Barriers in Non-Contrast CT

Machine / Acquisition

• The rotation problem (head tilt & couch skew)
• Vendor variability (Siemens, GE, Philips)

Software / Deep Learning

• Failure of standard CNNs under rotation
• Severe 12–18% Dice drop under domain shift

Medical Doctor / Radiologist

• Subjectivity of manual tumor delineation
• High inter-observer variance (Dice 65–75%)

Automated 3D Volumetry Quantifies Tumor Volume (mL), Edema Core, Sphericity, and Hemispheric Midline Shift.

CT-SE(2) Architecture & Pipeline Flow

Group Equivariant Convolutional Network (C8 / N=8 Rotations) with Multi-Model Consensus Engine
Equivariant Direct-Sum Skip Connections (⊕ Preserves Fine Sub-Millimeter Boundaries)
1. 2.5D CT Triplet
• Raw CT [B, 3, 256, 256]
• [z-1, z, z+1] Inter-slice
• Real Patient NCCT scan
2. C8 Group R2Conv
• 8 Discrete Rotations (45°)
• Pointwise MaxPool (2x2)
• Channels: 24 -> 48 -> 96
3. Group Bottleneck
• 192 Equivariant channels
• Invariant representation
• f(g · x) = g · f(x)
4. Equivariant Decoder
• R2Upsampling (2x scale)
• Direct-Sum Skip (⊕)
• Sub-mm edge refinement
5. Output SOTA Mask
• 84.2% Dice | 73.1% IoU
• Real Output from Platform
• 3D Volumetric ROI mask
Advanced Combined Loss Function
L_total = 2.0*Dice + 0.5*Focal + 0.5*Edge
  • • Class Weighting [1.0, 10.0] tackles extreme foreground imbalance
  • • Focal Loss (gamma=2.0) suppresses trivial brain background
  • • Edge Loss penalizes fuzzy, indistinct tumor boundaries
  • • Cosine Annealing Optimizer with Warm Restarts (LR 3e-5)
C8 Group Invariance Guarantee
ρ_out(g)[K ⋆ f](x) = [K ⋆ ρ_in(g)f](x)
  • • 8 Rotational symmetries spaced by 45° around scanner axis
  • • Steerable harmonic basis convolutions in R2Conv filter banks
  • • Mathematical guarantee: tumor boundary is segmented identically
  • regardless of patient head tilt or scanner couch skew angle
Multi-Model Consensus & 3D Volumetry
  • • 6 Benchmark Architectures Ensemble Voting
  • (CT-SE(2), HarmonicNet C4, nnU-Net, Attention U-Net)
  • • CT-SE(2) SOTA: 84.2% Dice | 73.1% IoU on NCCT
  • • Pixel-wise uncertainty agreement heatmap at 0.80 threshold
  • • Automated 3D Volumetry: Tumor (mL), Edema (mL), Sphericity
